name: Sci-Fi Calendar Pack
description: Science fiction calendar collection for Starfinder, Traveller, Star Trek, and other sci-fi settings

calendars.name: Ship City Standard Calendar (Coriolis: The Great Dark)
calendars.description: The Ship City Standard calendar used in The Great Dark, based on Old Horizon traditions and updated by the Navigators Guild. Features a 360-day Cycle-Orbit divided into 12 segments dedicated to Old Horizon systems.
calendars.preview: Sample format from Coriolis: The Great Dark
calendars.author: David Raynes

calendars.name: The Third Horizon Calendar (Coriolis)
calendars.description: The calendar system used throughout the Third Horizon in Coriolis. Features 9 Segments of 37 days each with intercalary holidays marking important religious and cultural observances.
calendars.preview: Sample format from Coriolis: The Third Horizon
calendars.author: David Raynes

calendars.name: Star Trek Calendar Variants
calendars.description: Calendar variants for Star Trek gaming sessions
calendars.preview: Sample format from Sci-Fi Calendar Pack
calendars.author: David Raynes

calendars.name: Absalom Station Calendar (Starfinder)
calendars.description: The galactic standard calendar used throughout the Pact Worlds, based on the ancient Golarion calendar but adapted for space travel and interplanetary coordination.
calendars.author: David Raynes

calendars.name: Imperial Calendar (Traveller)
calendars.description: The standardized Imperial Calendar used throughout the Third Imperium in the Traveller universe. Features a simplified system with a single 364-day year preceded by a holiday.
calendars.author: David Raynes
